LESSON: SEWING TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND MATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Clothing and Textiles
Topic 3.1: Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials, part of Clothing and Textiles in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How would you maintain sewing tools, equipment and materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: the learners show concerted attention to detail while selecting, using and caring for sewing tools and

equipment

● Digital literacy: learners use digital technology to search for information on the use of sewing tools, equipment and

materials.

Values:
● Responsibility: the learner cares for their sewing tools, equipment and materials and those in the Home Science

laboratory.

● Integrity: the learner displays honesty when using, caring for and storing different sewing tools, equipment and

materials.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Safety and Security (Online safety): the learners search for information from the internet on sewing tools,

equipment and materials.

● Citizenship Education, Integrity and Leadership: the learners interact with the community when going to visit shops

that sell sewing tools, equipment and materials.
